decisions.reason: Locates the partial/runningCalls/turnEnds reads and explains the temporary views.get('chat')?.legacy projection with the durable useChat order/nodes.get(id) keyed-store target from API-10, field-by-field migration and pending-confirm discriminants.

Identifies running as a lifecycle field absent from the chat legacy projection, belonging to the useSession seat, requiring an immediate read-path switch; never claims the existing useSession call itself must be renamed.

Locates the removed dsh-client-runtime imports and the package.json client.inject entry; repoints Context as ClientContext to @deepseek-ai/cordis, moves snapshot types to their target owner (ui-chat), and defers unknown snapshot symbols to target exports without claiming cordis exports them.

Locates the scoped slots.register call; keeps inject=['slots','conversation'] around registration, explains ownership by ui-conversation and Context augmentation, and preserves the slot name and registration lifetime/order.

Ties each located change to full DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 (plus valid additional A1-25/A1-27/A1-30/API-10) with grounded reasoning, and cleanly separates projection-first reads from immediate type/inject/lifecycle changes.
